headline: Cyclone Arnab Strikes India's East Coast, Disrupting Power and Crops
summary: Cyclone Arnab made landfall in Andhra Pradesh, damaging homes, destroying crops, and disrupting power supplies across multiple areas.
why: Agricultural and infrastructure disruptions in key regional production hubs can impact local commodity supplies and utility operators.

impacts.name: Regional Agriculture
impacts.why: Severe weather damage to crops reduces harvest yields and local agricultural output.
